leadText: Cerosi Town (Japanese: セルロスタウン Cellulos Town) is an -exclusive town located on Izabe Island in the Hoenn region. It was never seen onscreen, but it was mentioned in A Cacturne for the Worse, Beg, Burrow and Steal, Let it Snow, Let it Snow, Let it Snorunt!, and Do I Hear a Ralts?. , , , and Max were traveling to Cerosi Town because it has ferry services to Sootopolis City.
